title: Let forgiveness widen the whole room
summary: The line does not deny the wound; it refuses to let resentment keep writing the future. Keep this close: Remember this: received forgiveness becomes lasting peace when it ripens into Naam.
takeaway: Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
lifeApplication: When the old sentence rises again, release it before it claims the room and choose one softer answer instead of replay.

source.shortMeaning: Forgiveness turns private relief into shared peace.
source.lifeApplication: After forgiveness, let the next answer carry peace farther than your own relief.
